feeds.title: Farmtario » Livestock
feeds.description: Farmtario provides Ontario farmers with the most useful resources and information dedicated to the production of livestock in Ontario. We provide the most useful independent insight for Ontario farmers, including news, crop and livestock production, markets, and a deep understanding of how technology and data are being adopted on farms.

feeds.title: Alberta Farmer Express » Livestock
feeds.description: Alberta Farmer Express provides Alberta farmers and ranchers with the latest Livestock stories and features. Serving Canada's second-largest agricultural province, Alberta Farmer Express is widely recognized as the place where Alberta farmers and ranchers find out what's happening in agriculture, whether it's on local farms or farms around the world.

feeds.title: Canadian Cattlemen » Livestock
feeds.description: Read the latest and featured Livestock stories. Canadian Cattlemen brings relevant and informative Livestock articles to anyone in Canada's beef industry. Canadian Cattlemen magazine and website provides daily agriculture news to cattle ranchers and the general public with interest.

feeds.title: Grainews » Livestock
feeds.description: Grainews provides farmers with information about Livestock and practical production tips. Published 18 times per year, Grainews is written for farmers, and often by farmers, in a style they understand. Each issue also features Cattleman's Corner, with practical tips targeted for cow-calf producers and farmers with mixed cattle and grain operations.

feeds.title: The Western Producer » Livestock
feeds.description: Find the latest in livestock production, disease, and trades from the Western Producer, the best source for agricultural news for Canadian farmers. The Western Producer is the leading agricultural publication targeted for Western Canadian farmers and ranchers and has been a staple in the agricultural industry since 1923.

feeds.title: Small Farm Canada » Livestock
feeds.description: Explore a world of sustainable practices, cutting-edge technologies, and stories covering the dedication of countless farmers and ranchers. Small Farm Canada is a Canadian Farm Magazine that informs, entertains, and inspires small-scale farmers and their supporters.

feeds.title: Verified Beef Blog
feeds.description: Join us CBPP's experts as they navipagte the complexities of animal rearing, from breeding programs to feed formulations, and uncover the secrets to optimizing yield while ensuring animal welfare. Verified Beef Production Plus (VBP+) offers training and certification for beef producers across Canada, enabling producers to be validated in their good production practices.

feeds.title: Dairy and Beef Cattle Production
feeds.description: The Dairy and Beef Cattle Production blog is a place to find updates, information, and resources for Ontario dairy, veal, and beef producers. If you are a dairy, veal, or beef farmer in Ontario, then you should sign up for the Dairy and Beef Cattle Production blog or check back often as we have information and resources to help you.

feeds.title: Country Guide » Livestock
feeds.description: Country Guide provides Canadian farmers with the latest in livestock production and management to help their businesses succeed through strategic business thinking. Find news and perspectives shedding light on the livestock industry as a pillar of agricultural productivity.

feeds.title: Ontario Farmer » Livestock
feeds.description: From market updates and disease prevention tips to innovative farming practices and heartwarming stories of resilience, Ontario Farmer has got everything you need to keep your herd (or flock!) healthy and thriving. Ontario Farmer is a leading publication delivered weekly to subscribing farmers.

feeds.title: CowLife McGill Blog
feeds.description: Embark on a journey through the diverse landscapes of Canadas's livestock production, where tradition meets innovation. From the rolling pastures of cattle country to the state-of-the-art facilities of modern poultry operations, this blog celebrates the resilience and adaptability of farmers who dedicate their lives to nourishing nations.

feeds.title: RealAgriculture » Livestock
feeds.description: Delve into the latest trends, innovations, and best practices shaping the future of animal husbandry and discover how the livestock industry plays a vital role in meeting the world's growing demand for high-quality animal products.. RealAgriculture is a leading and only national agriculture publication in Canada focused on the issues that are impacting agriculture.
